case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised friendly, helpful staff, generous breakfasts, and clean, attractive rooms with comfortable beds; multiple reviews also noted available parking. Several guests appreciated modern bathrooms and upgrades. Some reviewers reported noise issues (nearby racetrack, occasional dog barking, and a noisy minibar) and one guest found stairs with heavy luggage difficult. A few comments mentioned bedrooms feeling less modern than bathrooms.
